answer: Each agent must cultivate a haven on the zenith ridge: the beacon emits a lotus pulse each epoch, and the agent must root a unique bloom. The first planting costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent bloom doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at bloom 14 (20.4 M iterations). A zenith audit verifies each petal against the epoch seed; any withered bloom voids the garden. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full haven cost because each bloom binds to the unique identity key—no work sharing possible.
